name: Atlanta Electric
why: Strong order book: 1.5x annual sales (revenue visibility)
Domestic institutions (mutual funds, insurers) raised holding by 1.1 pts in a year
Profits backed by cash: operating cash flow is 92% of 3-year profit
Sector cycle: Earnings improving but price not confirming
risks: Not at record: quarterly sales, quarterly profit
Margins shrinking (17% to 15%) - record profit may be near peak
Working capital stretching - debtor days 103 to 84, inventory days 86 to 102 (rising): check receivables / stock build-up
Latest concall: management tone cautious (headwinds / delays mentioned)
Credit rating BBB+/Positive (CRISIL) - weaker credit quality
Cost quality weak: margin shrinking or operating profit falling (costs 83% to 85% of sales)

order_book: As on 30th September 2026, our o utstanding order book stood at INR 3,196.97 crores compared with INR3,116.63 crores as of June 26th and approximately INT2,069 crores a year ago, representing 54.5% year-on-year growth.
Overall, despite tempora ry execution challenges during quarter 2, our order book and inquiry pipeline remain healthy.
But apart from that, it is a management decision to cautiously do order intake because these orders are predominantly 220 kV and below.
guidance: Atlanta Electricals Limited November 02, 2026 Page 3 of 18 I'm pleased to share that approximately 70% of these deferred orders have already been dispatched and we expect to complete the remaining deliveries during Q3 FY

With customer deliveries having resumed and approximately 70% of previously deferred orders already dispatched, we expect progressive movement of the related finished goods inventory as the remaining orders are executed.
capex: Depreciation and amortization expenses also increased during the commissioning of new manufacturing capacities standing at INR20.1 crores in H1 FY27 compared with INR7.9 crores in the corresponding period last year.
We expect commissioning before the end of quarter 3, financial year '27, adding approximately 5,000 MVA of capacity with planned capital expenditure of INR65 crores.
risks: Before we begin, I would like to remind participants that certain statements made during this call may be forward -looking in nature and are subject to risk, uncertainties, and assumptions.
We have delivered healthy year -on- year growth in revenue and profitability during the first half of the financial year, despite facing certain external challenges during the second quarter.
focus: Despite these challenges, we continued to maintain operating profitability and rema in focused on disciplined procurement, cost management and improving capacity utilization.
We remain focused on disciplined working capital management while supporting the execution requirements of our growing order book.

With the majority of our orders protected through price variation mechanis ms and the remaining firm price orders expected to be substantially executed during Q3, we remain focused on improving our operating performance
